account: It is nineteen o'clock on day 0, and I am at town hall, due to go home. Today appears to have been quiet: the secretary reported no new correspondence or business, and the neighbour described a peaceful riverside with no request for town hall. The baker has been spreading word of fresh bread at the market, which sounds like ordinary trade. Someone called freight apparently arrived during office hours, but I have heard no explanation of their business, so I cannot draw conclusions. The noteworthy change to tomorrow's routine is the innkeeper's requested meeting about the inn's service to town. The innkeeper will meet me at my office at 17:45 and accompany me to the great hall for 18:00. The secretary recorded this in an approved supplement; I read it and returned all three appointment documents to the chest. I do not yet know the specific proposal or concern behind that meeting. Tomorrow also includes the morning grain inspection at the east-bank mill, office business, and fifteen-o'clock tea with the neighbour. Nothing I have personally seen or heard establishes any trouble or hidden purpose.
